title: Session Soundboard, Cue Stack, Playlist & Live-GM Audio Control

selection_basis.reduced_strict_order: MSAS-01 → MSAS-03 → MSAS-04 → MSAS-05 → MSAS-07 → MSAS-09 → MSAS-12 → MSAS-14 → MSAS-15 → MSAS-18 → MSAS-21
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MRCS-11 remains selected_not_started; MVPS-18 remains selected_not_started.

objective: Implement the audio-domain live-session control surface for soundboards, cue stacks and playlists using Packet-07 typed preview/dry-run/commit/receipt/intervention semantics and AAI runtime identities, while preventing GM audio controls from becoming generic gameplay authority or manufacturing canonical Events.
boundaries: MSAS-01 through MSAS-14 remain prior studio, semantic, voice and spatial foundations consumed by this tranche.
AAI retains canonical cue/soundscape semantics and runtime playback/layering/mixer authority; MSAS-15 supplies the bounded live-control authoring/trigger surface over those identities.

PDCP Packet-07 retains generic preview, dry-run, commit, explanation, live-GM intervention, debug and recovery semantics; MSAS-15 consumes those typed primitives rather than inventing generic GM-control authority.
A soundboard or cue-stack trigger is audio-domain control intent and cannot manufacture a canonical gameplay Event, Scene transition, Combat change or World-state occurrence.
Preview/dry-run is visibly noncommitting and cannot be confused with committed audio control.
Playlist/cue-stack ordering, recovery and receipts remain deterministic and explicit.
Permissions/visibility filters from owning systems remain external authority and cannot be widened by the soundboard.
Local/provider-off live audio control remains blocking-capable.
Meaningful sonic cues retain non-audio accessibility alternatives where applicable.
MSAS-18+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
MRCS and MVPS lane state remains independent.
next_action: MSAS-15 is completed_verified. MSAS-18 is selected_not_started under the reduced strict order. MRCS and MVPS remain independent and were preserved from fresh CURRENT.json.
